title: Does Every Instance Count Equally? Order Effects in LLM Multi-Instance Processing
abstract: arXiv:2610.29057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Users increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to analyse collections of independent inputs, such as product reviews or social media posts, and return a single aggregated answer. This setting requires multi-instance processing (MIP), where a model combines information from multiple instances into one prediction. We study a task in which the model must infer a binary label for each instance, and identify the most frequent label among the full instance set. The correct answer should be invariant to instance order. By evaluating fifteen LLMs across five datasets and seven instance order patterns, with each instance set held fixed across patterns, we find substantial order sensitivity. Accuracy can differ by about 90 percentage points between the best and worst order patterns, with models generally more accurate when majority-label instances appear at the start than when they appear in the middle or at the end. translated_title: 每个实例都同等重要吗？大语言模型多实例处理中的顺序效应
translated_abstract: 用户越来越多地依赖大语言模型（LLM）来分析由独立输入组成的集合，例如产品评论或社交媒体帖子，并返回一个单一的汇总答案。这种场景需要多实例处理（MIP），即模型将来自多个实例的信息整合为一个预测。我们研究了一项任务：模型必须为每个实例推断一个二元标签，并在整个实例集中识别出现频率最高的标签。正确答案应当对实例顺序保持不变。通过在五个数据集和七种实例顺序模式下评估十五个大语言模型，并在各模式间保持实例集固定不变，我们发现存在显著的顺序敏感性。最佳与最差顺序模式之间的准确率差异可达约90个百分点；与多数标签实例出现在中间或末尾相比，当它们出现在开头时，模型通常表现得更准确。对于部分模型……
tldr: 大语言模型在多实例聚合任务中存在显著的顺序敏感性，最佳与最差实例顺序之间的准确率差异可达约90个百分点，且当多数标签实例位于开头时模型表现最佳。
en_tdlr: LLMs exhibit substantial order sensitivity in multi-instance processing, with accuracy differing by up to about 90 percentage points across order patterns, and models perform best when majority-label instances appear at the start.
